education.title: B.S. Cybersecurity, Minor in Political Science
education.detail: GPA 3.5/4.0. Focused on security operations, network security, and cyber policy. Hands-on lab work with Linux, packet and log analysis, intrusion detection, and secure infrastructure design, paired with coursework on governance and cyber law.

work.title: Student SOC Analyst
work.org: Old Dominion University Student Security Operations Center · Norfolk, VA
work.detail: Selected for a competitive two-semester program with a summer internship, monitoring and responding to live threats across the university on rotating CrowdStrike, PagerDuty, and user investigation shifts. Triage phishing in PagerDuty against 85%+ accuracy, sub-2-min MTTA, and sub-40-min MTTR targets. Investigate risky sign-ins and compromised accounts in Entra ID and QRadar SIEM using KQL. Identified and contained unauthorized software installs across multiple faculty endpoints in CrowdStrike Falcon, linking the activity to an active malvertising campaign. Document investigations per SOC SOPs and brief findings to SOC staff.

work.title: Staff Instructor, CyberAI Summer Camp
work.detail: Designed and delivered a week-long curriculum on cybersecurity and AI, covering AI-enabled attacks, phishing analysis, and model training fundamentals. Authored all course materials, including slide decks, speaker scripts, and hands-on phishing analysis labs, plus Jeopardy review games with a real-time Firebase buzzer system.
